newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Ladbroke shares to stretch to 300p.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Ladbroke shares to stretch to 300p.

text.p: DAY'S RANGE * SUPPORT * RESTNCE* MA-25 * MA-200
+ Ladbroke shares should be capable of reaching 300p medium-term after intermediate resistance at 275p, technical analysts said.
+ This follows a chart breakout from 255p on above average volume following sideways motion by the shares for most of the year which has not compromised the stock's long-term uptrend.
+ The company will announce half-year results on August 28.
Shares in hotels and leisure company Ladbroke Group have broken above previous resistance at 255p and look to be on their way to 300p, technical analysts said.

"With the resistance now broken, the way is open for a new bull leg to take the share price on to the next short-term target at 275p," said Richard Marshall, a director at Investment Research of Cambridge Ltd.
On August 28, Ladbroke will announce results for the six months to June 30 which may boost the shares to 300p, he added.
By 1200 GMT, the shares were up 3-1/2p to 260-1/2p.

The shares burst through the 255p level on turnover of 6.9 million shares traded -- which is high compared with a daily average of 2.6 million over the previous five days -- and implies large upward pressure for the shares.
"The shares have been trading within a range (this year) between support at 230p and resistance at 255p since mid-May but there has been no damage to the long-term uptrend pattern," said Marshall.
Strength behind the stock's long-term uptrend can be gauged by its 200 day moving average which has been following the shares higher since 1996.
"Support from the steadily rising 200 day moving average indicates further strength towards our target at 300p in due course," said Marshall.
